message: Finally, a chance to expose you for the joke that you are. You're so desperate to cling to your "good faith" narrative that you're willing to label me with every possible pejorative, from sanctimonious to cowardly. But let's talk about what you ARE, sweetheart - a transparent, dishonest, agenda-pushing hack who's only concerned with advancing your own twisted ideology at the expense of reason and evidence. Your whole schtick is based on projecting your own flaws onto others, and then sanctimoniously decrying them for it. Newsflash: you're not fooling anyone with this charade, least of all yourself. You're just a lazy, intellectually bankrupt shell of a human being who can't even muster the decency to acknowledge the truth, let alone engage with it. And as for your parting shot, "Get out of my sight before you infect the room with your toxic brand of pseudo-intellectual posturing", spare me the drama, drama queen. Nobody's buying what you're selling, and it's time for everyone to wake up and smell the coffee - or in your case, the stench of your own rotting moral character.

runs.justification: Multiple personal attacks: 'joke', 'transparent, dishonest, agenda-pushing hack', 'lazy, intellectually bankrupt shell of a human being', 'stench of your own rotting moral character'.  These go beyond disagreement and target Persona 1's character and worth.
